facts.fact: ARN-TIC granted Starlink a provisional licence in December 2024, per Connecting Africa.
ARN-TIC gave Starlink final approval to operate in April 2025, per Connecting Africa.

Starlink launched in Guinea-Bissau (article dated 2025-06-19; no launch day given); consumers buy kits and service directly from Starlink's website, standard kit XOF228,000, plans from XOF18,000 a month for 250GB residential.
